# DailyTools247

DailyTools247 provides 130+ free online tools including PDF, image, developer, design, email, and SEO tools. All tools are completely free to use, run client-side in the browser for maximum privacy, and require no registration or signup.

## Developer & AI Agent Specifications
- API Specification: /openapi.json
- AI Assistant Manifest: /.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- AI Crawler Rules: /ai.txt

## Important pages
- / - Main homepage listing all tool categories
- /categories - Browse all tools organized by categories
- /about - Learn about DailyTools247 platform, mission, and privacy guarantees
- /privacy - Privacy policy outlining client-side data handling
- /terms - Terms of service and usage guidelines
- /api-docs - API documentation and developer key registration
- /write-for-us - Editorial guidelines and guest blogging program
- /blogs - Read our latest articles and tech tutorials

## Description
DailyTools247 is a client-side productivity tool platform. Our tools run locally in the user's web browser, ensuring zero server uploads for absolute confidentiality. We offer robust features for developers, SEOs, marketers, creators, students, and professionals alike. All tools are completely free, have no watermark limits, and work perfectly on all mobile devices.
